title: Invertibility of the restricted natural comparison on the sum of bounded-flat stages
statement: Let $f:Z\to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-proper-morphism], with derived categories in a common universe [def-pc-derived-category], the recorded derived pullback $F$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] carrying a strong monoidal structure [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and additive termwise tensor pullback $H$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let $q$ be the homotopy quotient of cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], and put $L=F\circ Q_Y$, $G=Q_Z\circ H^h$. Suppose $\alpha_X:LX\to GX$ is a family on flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map], natural for every homotopy morphism between its objects. Suppose $\alpha_X$ is invertible whenever $X$ also lies in boundedFlatShiftRepresentative [def-sc-bounded-flat-shift-representative]. For any sequence $E_n$ of bounded-above complexes with flat terms [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], with an individual upper bound for each $n$, there exist a cochain complex $R$, a proof that $R$ is a literal flat telescope, and a homotopy isomorphism $q(\bigoplus_n E_n)\cong qR$, such that $\alpha_{qR}$ evaluated using this literal unshifted representative is invertible. There are no transition maps between the $E_n$, no shifted-unit comparison, and no normalized shift equation in the hypotheses; there is no assertion about the cone of an arbitrary transition endomorphism.

source.place: Finite-partial-sum and coproduct part of step 1 of lem-sc-flat-telescope-normalization-unshifted-is-iso; inherited agent expansion, not a literal statement of either tag.

proof.text: Apply exists_flat_telescope_sum_models to E, hb and hf. Obtain R,hR,T,hT,s, the required homotopy isomorphism, the boundedness predicates on qT_n and a colimiting cofan with vertex qR.

Apply flat_comparison_preserves_countable_coproducts. Map the homotopy cofan by L and G, obtaining colimiting cofans. For b_n = alpha(qT_n), the bounded hypothesis supplies IsIso b_n. Naturality gives L(s_n) followed by a = b_n followed by G(s_n), where a = alpha(qR). Define d:G(qR) -> L(qR) using the G cofan and legs inverse(b_n) followed by L(s_n). On each L coprojection, a followed by d is identity by the naturality square and b_n followed by its inverse. On each G coprojection, d followed by a is identity by the same square and inverse(b_n) followed by b_n. Colimit hom_ext proves both identities and hence IsIso a. Return R,hR and its homotopy isomorphism.

theorem exists_flat_telescope_sum_comparison_isIso
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian Z] [IsNoetherian Y] (f : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [Functor.Monoidal (derivedPullback f)]
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive]
    (α : ∀ X : HomotopyCategory
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ),
        flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X →
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).obj X ⟶
            ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
              (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                schemeDerivedCategory Z)).obj X))
    (hαnat : (∀ (X X' : HomotopyCategory
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X) (hX' : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X')
          (s : X ⟶ X'),
          (DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f).map s ≫ (α X' hX') =
            (α X hX) ≫
              ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
                (DerivedCategory.Qh : HomotopyCategory
                  (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⥤
                  schemeDerivedCategory Z)).map s))
    (hαbounded : ∀ (X : HomotopyCategory
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
      (hX : flatTelescopeShiftRepresentative Y X),
      boundedFlatShiftRepresentative Y X → IsIso (α X hX))
    (E : ℕ → CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hb : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → IsZero ((E n).X i))
    (hf : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E n).X i)) :
    ∃ (R : CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
      (hR : isFlatTelescope Y R),
      Nonempty ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (∐ E) ≅
        (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj R) ∧
      IsIso (α ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj R)
        ⟨R, hR, Or.inl rfl⟩)
